paracetamol.uses: Relieves pain and reduces a high temperature.
paracetamol.side_effects: Side effects are uncommon when used correctly; allergic reactions can occur.
paracetamol.warnings: Too much can cause serious liver harm. Avoid accidentally combining products containing the same ingredient. No dosing advice is provided here.

ibuprofen.uses: Relieves pain and reduces inflammation and fever.
ibuprofen.side_effects: Can cause stomach upset, nausea, dizziness or a rash.
ibuprofen.warnings: May be unsuitable with some medical conditions or medicines. A pharmacist should review other NSAIDs, blood thinners and blood-pressure medicines.

warfarin.uses: An anticoagulant used to prevent and treat blood clots.
warfarin.warnings: Other medicines can affect treatment. Consult the prescribing clinician or pharmacist before medicine changes.
